case.summary: This case was triggered when the real-time model scored an online transaction of $125.08 at 0.52. The graph and case memory showed a new device profile and a product code never used before on this card, alongside a history of two earlier confirmed account takeover cases in August 2016 which resulted in card reissues. The case-memory model estimated a calibrated fraud rate of 0.7% with a final fraud probability of 0.01. The verdict is legitimate because the cardholder confirmed the transaction as their own during simulated step-up authentication. The case has been closed with no fraud.
